rules.name: Application Launch Stability
rules.notApplicableReason: Applies to every app; a crash on launch is never acceptable.
rules.detectionMethod: Requires running the app on a device or simulator-equivalent; static source analysis cannot prove launch stability.
rules.remediation: Reproduce the launch crash on a device, fix the root cause, and re-test on the oldest supported iOS version.
rules.verification: Manual launch test on a physical device across supported iOS versions.
rules.evidence: Tester notes with device model, iOS version and result.

rules.name: Review Demo Account Availability
rules.notApplicableReason: The app has no user accounts, so no demo account is needed for review.

officialReference.title: App Review Guidelines 2.1 App Completeness (demo account information)

rules.detectionMethod: The demo account lives in App Store Connect review information; it cannot be read from source.
rules.remediation: Provide a working demo account (or a demo mode) in App Store Connect review notes.
rules.verification: Check App Store Connect App Review Information manually.
rules.evidence: Confirmation that credentials are present and active.

rules.name: Demo Account Validation
rules.notApplicableReason: The app has no user accounts, so there is no demo account to validate.

officialReference.title: App Review Guidelines 2.1 App Completeness (demo account information)

rules.detectionMethod: Requires signing in with the supplied credentials against the production backend.
rules.remediation: Refresh expired credentials, make sure the account has the data needed to reach all features, and re-verify before submission.
rules.verification: Manual sign-in with the supplied demo credentials immediately before submission.
rules.evidence: Date and result of the manual sign-in.

rules.name: Feature Discoverability
rules.notApplicableReason: Applies to every app; reviewers must be able to find all features.
rules.detectionMethod: Needs human judgement of the running UI and review notes.
rules.remediation: Explain hidden or gated features in the review notes and make main features reachable without special setup.
rules.verification: Reviewer-style walkthrough of the app.

rules.name: Privacy Policy
rules.notApplicableReason: The app is not distributed through the App Store, so App Store privacy policy requirements do not apply.

officialReference.title: App Review Guidelines 5.1.1 Data Collection and Storage (privacy policy)

rules.detectionMethod: The privacy policy URL is set in App Store Connect and must be reachable and accurate; this needs URL reachability and human review.
rules.remediation: Publish an accurate privacy policy, link it in App Store Connect and inside the app.
rules.verification: Open the URL and compare the policy with actual data practices.
rules.evidence: URL, fetch date and reviewer notes.

rules.name: Metadata Consistency
rules.notApplicableReason: The app is not distributed through the App Store, so App Store metadata rules do not apply.
rules.detectionMethod: Would compare app name, description and keywords with app behaviour; needs App Store Connect data and judgement.
rules.remediation: Align name, subtitle, description and keywords with what the app actually does.
rules.verification: Manual comparison of App Store Connect metadata with the build.

rules.name: Support URL
rules.notApplicableReason: The app is not distributed through the App Store, so a support URL is not required.
rules.detectionMethod: Requires checking that the URL is reachable and offers real contact or support options.
rules.remediation: Provide a working support page with contact information.
rules.verification: Open the URL and confirm it responds with real support content.
rules.evidence: URL, HTTP result and fetch date.

rules.name: Subscription Disclosure
rules.notApplicableReason: The app has no subscriptions, so subscription disclosure requirements do not apply.
rules.detectionMethod: Would check the paywall for price, period, renewal and cancellation disclosure; needs UI review.
rules.remediation: Show price, billing period, auto-renewal terms and how to cancel clearly before purchase.
rules.verification: Manual review of the paywall UI.

rules.name: Terms of Use / EULA
rules.notApplicableReason: The app has no subscriptions, so a Terms of Use link is not required for subscription disclosure.
rules.detectionMethod: Would check for a Terms of Use (EULA) link in the app and in App Store metadata.
rules.remediation: Link the Terms of Use (or the standard Apple EULA) in the paywall and in App Store Connect.
rules.verification: Manual check of in-app and App Store Connect links.

rules.name: Pricing Transparency
rules.notApplicableReason: The app has no subscriptions, so subscription pricing display rules do not apply.
rules.detectionMethod: Would check that the billed amount is the most prominent price and that trial terms are explicit; needs UI review.
rules.remediation: Make the billed price clear, and show trial length and post-trial price.
rules.verification: Manual review of price presentation.

rules.name: Restore Purchases
rules.notApplicableReason: The app has no subscriptions or in-app purchases, so a restore mechanism is not required.

officialReference.title: App Review Guidelines 3.1.1 In-App Purchase (restore purchases)

rules.detectionMethod: Source-level detector searches for restore-purchases calls (StoreKit restore or sync APIs) when purchases exist. It cannot prove the control is visible or works at runtime.
rules.remediation: Add a visible Restore Purchases control that calls the StoreKit restore flow.
rules.verification: Source detector plus manual test with a sandbox account.
rules.evidence: Matched file and line, or absence of any restore call.

rules.name: External Payment Compliance
rules.notApplicableReason: The app has no external payment links, so external payment rules do not apply.

officialReference.title: App Review Guidelines 3.1.1 In-App Purchase and 3.1.3 Other Purchase Methods

rules.detectionMethod: Allowed external purchase links depend on storefront and entitlements; this needs human judgement. Never blanket-ban external links and never add them automatically.
rules.remediation: Review each external link against the storefront and any entitlement held; remove or gate links that are not permitted. Do not add external payment links automatically.
rules.verification: Manual review of storefront and entitlement status.
rules.evidence: Link inventory with storefront and entitlement notes.

rules.name: Account Deletion
rules.notApplicableReason: The app has no user accounts, so account deletion is not required.

officialReference.title: App Review Guidelines 5.1.1(v) Account Sign-In (account deletion)

rules.detectionMethod: Source-level detector looks for account deletion UI or API calls when accounts exist. It cannot verify that the backend really deletes data.
rules.remediation: Offer in-app account deletion that initiates deletion of the account and its data.
rules.verification: Source detector plus manual deletion test.
rules.evidence: Matched file and line, or absence of any deletion flow.

rules.name: Sign in with Apple
rules.notApplicableReason: The app does not use third-party social login, so Sign in with Apple is not required.
rules.detectionMethod: Source-level detector checks whether Sign in with Apple is present when third-party social login is used. It cannot judge whether an exception applies. Never add Sign in with Apple blindly.
rules.remediation: Evaluate whether an exemption applies; if not, offer Sign in with Apple or an equivalent login service. Do not add it automatically.
rules.verification: Source detector plus human judgement on exemptions.
rules.evidence: Detected social providers and the Sign in with Apple finding.

rules.name: Permission Purpose Strings
rules.notApplicableReason: The app does not use camera, microphone, location or photos, so usage description strings are not required.

officialReference.title: App Review Guidelines 5.1.1 Data Collection and Storage (permission purpose strings)

rules.detectionMethod: Source-level detector flags missing or empty Info.plist usage descriptions for used permissions. Whether a string is specific and honest, and whether unused permissions remain, still needs review.
rules.remediation: Add a specific, honest purpose string per permission and remove permissions the app does not use.
rules.verification: Source detector plus manual wording review.
rules.evidence: Info.plist keys and the missing or empty ones.

rules.name: App Tracking Transparency
rules.notApplicableReason: The app does not track users, so no App Tracking Transparency prompt is needed (and none should be shown).

officialReference.title: App Review Guidelines 5.1.2 Data Use and Sharing

rules.detectionMethod: Would check that the ATT prompt exists when tracking is used and is absent when it is not; needs data-flow review.
rules.remediation: Request ATT before tracking, or remove the tracking and any ATT prompt.
rules.verification: Manual review of SDKs and data flows.

rules.name: Placeholder Content
rules.notApplicableReason: Applies to every app; placeholder content is never acceptable.
rules.detectionMethod: Source-level detector scans for placeholder strings such as lorem ipsum or TODO text in shipped sources and resources. It cannot see images or server content.
rules.remediation: Replace placeholder text and assets with final content.
rules.verification: Source detector plus manual UI walkthrough.

rules.name: Screenshot Accuracy
rules.notApplicableReason: The app is not distributed through the App Store, so App Store screenshots do not apply.
rules.detectionMethod: Needs the uploaded screenshots and a human comparison with the real app.
rules.remediation: Use screenshots that show the real app in use.
rules.verification: Manual comparison of screenshots with the build.

rules.name: Branding Consistency
rules.notApplicableReason: Applies to every app; the name and branding must be consistent.
rules.detectionMethod: Source-level detector compares names declared in project files (for example display name versus other declared names). It cannot compare against store metadata or icons.
rules.remediation: Use one consistent app name and branding across project files and store metadata.
rules.verification: Source detector plus manual store metadata comparison.

rules.name: Age Rating
rules.notApplicableReason: The app is not distributed through the App Store, so no App Store age rating is needed.

officialReference.title: App Review Guidelines 2.3 Accurate Metadata (age rating)

rules.detectionMethod: The rating questionnaire is answered in App Store Connect and needs human judgement of the content.
rules.remediation: Answer the questionnaire truthfully. The rating is never changed automatically or randomly.
rules.verification: Manual review of the questionnaire answers.

rules.name: Template / Copycat Detection
rules.notApplicableReason: Applies to every app; repackaged template or copycat apps risk rejection.

officialReference.title: App Review Guidelines 4.3 Spam and 4.1 Copycats

rules.detectionMethod: Would assess similarity to templates and other apps; needs external comparison and human judgement.
rules.remediation: Add distinctive functionality and original design; avoid reusing another developer's app or template unchanged.
rules.verification: Manual originality review.

rules.name: Feature Claims Verification
rules.notApplicableReason: The app is not distributed through the App Store, so store feature claims do not apply.
rules.detectionMethod: Would match claims in the description with implemented features; needs metadata and judgement.
rules.remediation: Remove or implement every feature claimed in the metadata.
rules.verification: Manual claim-by-claim check.

rules.name: Minimum App Functionality
rules.notApplicableReason: Applies to every app; an app must offer more than a bare web wrapper.
rules.detectionMethod: Would flag apps that only load a website in a web view; needs behavioural judgement.
rules.remediation: Add native functionality and value beyond a repackaged website.
rules.verification: Manual review of app functionality.

rules.name: Rejection Analysis & Appeal
rules.notApplicableReason: The app is not distributed through the App Store, so there is no App Review rejection to analyse.
rules.detectionMethod: Module design only: analyse a rejection message, map it to rules and draft a reply. Any appeal sent to Apple requires explicit user approval and is never sent automatically.
rules.remediation: Draft the analysis and reply for the user to review; the user submits any appeal.
rules.verification: Not available; sending an appeal always requires explicit user approval.
